data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. The v4.2 update introduced new SSO token handling. Please perform a clean reinstall of the application, ensuring you uninstall and restart your device before reinstalling. If the error continues, please have your company's SSO administrator review the identity provider's token settings or regenerate the client secret in the Admin Console. [T-2435] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
